title: Southern Yemeni group re-emerges as war escalates
gist: Brief podcast summary: a southern Yemeni group re-emerges as the war escalates, attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz are rising, and a Saudi citizen working for OpenAI was charged with allegedly spying on his employer.
